highlights: Develop mobile apps, backend services, and web platforms across multiple products, handling development, debugging, and delivery.

Built REST APIs, integrated databases, and optimized application performance with scalable architectures.
Contributed to the Tybee Go mobile app and Findanio mobile and web apps, enhancing cross-platform UI for Android and iOS.
Accelerated development using Cursor, Antigravity, Git, and GitHub to build clean, efficient, and maintainable solutions.
